html:
Ieremia Tabai led Kiribati to independence on 12 July 1979 and became its first president, at just 29, serving until 1991.

He came to power as chief minister of the Gilbert Islands colony. A national fund built up from the phosphate of Banaba still supports the state.

Tabai kept government small and wary of foreign aid and debt. In 1985 he made a fishing deal with the Soviet Union, which alarmed the United States and Australia. He later led the Pacific Islands Forum secretariat. See also Anote Tong.
